notes: ACCESS: tier (a) HTTP-first via requests (robots.txt has no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot disallow; full site otherwise allowed). Playwright (tier b) was attempted but every navigation attempt to jcpenney.com failed at the network layer (ERR_HTTP2_PROTOCOL_ERROR / ERR_CONNECTION_RESET / timeout) in this sandbox even with --disable-http2, while plain HTTP requests succeeded reliably, so tier (a) was used exclusively and proved sufficient/reliable; tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome was not needed. TREE: JCPenney is a Next.js-style SSR app; the rendered mega-menu/flyer nav is not present in the static HTML (client-hydrated), so the category tree was built from the union of jcpenney.com's own XML sitemaps (sitemap.xml -> category-for-the-home.xml, category-home.xml, facet-home.xml, facet-for-the-home.xml, globalnav.xml, marketing.xml), de-duplicated by (URL path, category id), restricted to /g/home* and /d/home* paths, then cross-checked against anchor links scraped from the SSR'd /d/bed-and-bath and home-store pages. QTY: each candidate category id was queried directly against JCPenney's own product-listing data API (Constructor.io browse endpoint, https://ac.cnstrc.com/browse/group_id/<id>?key=key_xT77K5VmpiVduqnj, the same key/endpoint the site's own PLP JS calls client-side) and the response's total_num_results / groups[0].count and groups[0].display_name (used to verify the node's own name matches the requested category) were recorded verbatim as qty and evidence - no number was estimated or aggregated. A handful of sitemap ids (Craft Storage, Garage & Tool Storage, Kids Storage, Safes, Trash Cans, Bathroom Trash Cans & Bags, and a duplicate 'comforters-bedding-sets' / 'decor/throws' id) returned an empty/invalid response (no display_name, 0 results) from this API, indicating stale/retired sitemap entries; these were dropped rather than fabricated. GROUPING: parent nodes that are clearly heterogeneous department-level umbrellas mixing multiple distinct product types (All Bath, All Bedding, Storage & Organization, Window Treatments) were recorded as grouping rows (is_group, no qty/link) per the parent-URL rule; parent nodes that are themselves a single well-defined product type with only a narrower style/feature sub-filter beneath them (Bath Towels/Beach Towels, Blankets & Throws/Electric Blankets & Throws, Curtains & Drapes/{Blackout,Multi-Pack,Sheer,Valances}) retained their own qty as a leaf alongside the narrower child, since collapsing them to null would have discarded the site's real, much larger top-level count. EXCLUDED (and why): Bathroom Accessories & Sets (972, mixed decorative non-textile items e.g. soap dispensers/tumblers/trash cans, not primarily textile/storage); Cold Weather Bedding (1464, seasonal merchandising collection per rule 15/27); All Blinds & Shades (185), Cellular Blinds (42), Vertical Blinds (7), Wood & Faux Wood Blinds (18), Made to Measure Blinds & Shades (93), Mini Blinds (9), Curtain Rods & Hardware (1098) (hard/mixed-material window coverings and hardware, not textile per rule 5/6); Room Darkening (1073), Sheer (373), Window Light Filtration Level x2 (153, 1715) (facet/attribute landing pages, not genuine subcategory listings); 'Décor > Window Treatments' alias id (near-duplicate of the canonical Window Treatments node, ~same count); 'Chair Cushions' home-decor id (duplicate of Chair Cushions & Covers, identical count 81); second 'Rugs' id cat1009770007 (near-duplicate of the retained Rugs node); Linens (5413) and Bed & Bath (6657) (generic shop-all aggregate pages superseded by their specific subcategories per rule 25/27); Lunch Bags & Totes (personal carrying bags, not home storage per rule 6); Irons & Laundry Care (laundry appliances, not laundry storage/textile); Buffets & Storage (72), Media Storage (155), Media & Storage Furniture (346) (explicitly placed under the Furniture-store nav branch by the site, Furniture task's domain per Storage Furniture Boundary rule); All Trash & Recycling and Bathroom Trash Cans & Bags (waste management, not storage); Luggage, Pet Care, Electronics, all furniture/lighting/mirror/clock/candle/dinnerware/cookware/flatware/glassware categories, and all private-label brand pages (Linden Street, Fieldcrest, Distant Lands, Home Expressions, Brookstone, Sharper Image, Loom & Forge) (out of Textile/Storage scope or not a genuine product category). Department store scope was limited throughout to the Home Store department (dept20000011); fashion/apparel/jewelry/beauty/shoes departments were not traversed.
